answer: Locks are recorded in copper, expire in mirror, and kernel lists each expiry. Someone running 72 aliases as a result needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1910 identities would post 3716 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
